entries.c2c_document_section_versions: derived — the per-section version ledger (migrations/20260528_phase9_document_schema.sql). Keyed through its parent chain: section_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES c2c_document_sections(id) -> document_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES c2c_documents(id) -> c2c_documents.org_id integer NOT NULL. Its one per-request reader, documentAuthors() in server/services/governance/separation-of-duties.ts (added by 610f687, 2026-09-22), joins exactly that chain and filters d.org_id = $2, where $2 is the caller's org from resolveOrgId(req) in server/routes/c2c/actions.ts (401 when absent), and it selects only author_id. The intermediate c2c_document_sections is itself still unreviewed here, so the tenant key is two joins away and no RLS policy covers either child: isolation rests on that predicate. Classified 2026-09-23.

entries.mcp_oauth_clients: global — the RFC 7591 dynamic client registry of the MCP connector's OAuth 2.1 authorization server (migrations/20260920_mcp_oauth.sql, whose Notes record the decision). Registration happens BEFORE any user authenticates, so there is no tenant to bind a row to; a row holds only the client's own metadata (client_id, redirect URIs, display name, optional client_secret) and nothing about any organisation. Read only by getClient() in server/mcp/auth/store.ts, by client_id, under runWithPreAuthScope — a tenant policy would hide every client from that pre-auth lookup. Tenant binding lives on the grant: mcp_oauth_authorization_codes and mcp_oauth_refresh_tokens carry organization_id INTEGER NOT NULL and a membership_id FK to organization_users, and are swept. Classified 2026-09-23.

entries.platform_settings: global — one value per DEPLOYMENT, not per customer: governed platform settings (today only module_enforcement_mode, the off/report/enforce ladder for route entitlement enforcement). No customer content; identical for every tenant by construction; a per-organization mode would be a different table (see the SCOPE note in db/migrations/20260824_enforcement_mode_setting.sql). Must stay UNPOLICIED, not merely unkeyed: moduleEntitlementGate -> enforcement-mode.ts readStoredMode() reads it on the shared pool under whatever per-user tenant scope the request carries, so a tenant policy would hide the stored mode from every tenant request and silently fall back to the deployment env value. Written only by PATCH /api/admin/master/licensing/enforcement/mode (authMiddleware + requirePlatformAdmin, SYSTEM scope). Posture pinned on a provisioned DB by tests/db/entitlement-schema-posture.dbtest.ts. Classified 2026-09-22.
